lessons.statement: Nineteen projects closed in unauthorised tranches because no close path read the tranche authorisation; one gate function now refuses a closure whose tranche is not authorised.
The conformance standard over-required the programme-level Preliminary artefacts on every project; the Preliminary set is capability-scoped and per-project sets start at A.
The record harness mapped no lifecycle write, so a closure could not be read back; the map, the review read and a snapshot read-back now exist.
SAFe was adopted in the spec and not operable: no demo-credit or lesson action, no conformance rule and no output category. The cadence is now executable and enforced.
The frozen public pack understated the live record by five P0s; the publish path now audits a fresh snapshot before it replaces the pack.

S02's acceptance issue #2 named a two-worker long-handler proof that did not exist on main or the branch; the project was active while its acceptance instrument could never go green. The proof now exists as apps/server/tests/jobs_lease_two_workers.rs (P2.1-P2.3) and passes locally; a named Verify with no test is a finding, not a waiver.

T1 closed on 2026-11-17 before tranche 1 was authorised, with no charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract or Phase-G review authored at the time; the retrospective records do not attest contemporaneous intent, and the out-of-sequence close is carried as the accepted P0 exception U3-EXC-T1.

T11's closure can claim only the metrics/metering mechanism and its tests: the live record has no C0-C5 threshold row calibrated from real run and approval data, and the original close date is not recoverable. Measuring the maturity levels needs a recorded threshold and measured evidence, not prose.

A write whose read-back is a list action could not use the created id as the list input; the PI cadence create got a 422 on its read-back and was verified afterwards by hand. The harness now keeps the list action's own input and matches the created id in the returned rows, with a self-test case.

The rework runner skipped an expected output when a row of its category already existed, so a published project-brief or evidence page could keep claiming the pre-rework state while the closure claimed the new one. The runner now corrects the body through unpublish -> update -> publish and re-runs the category heading gate.

A property the code does not hold is not a property: claim exclusivity was stated while repeat claims were permitted and the race test never exercised the repeat path, so a stated property needs a test that fails when the property is removed.
An 'every' claim needs a census, not an example: two card indexes still do not filter archived rows. The finding is still open.

A gated artefact has more than one door: documents.update refused a generated draft but documents.compose wrote card_id without consulting meta.generated, so the gate must sit on every write path that can attach a model output, not only the one the spec names.
Publishing a refinement is a policy change: the gate belongs on the publication of a rule, not only on the rule's creation.

A caller-visible refusal code is part of the contract: the budget refusal returns tool_budget_exceeded where the spec names budget_exceeded, and a test written from the implementation cannot prove the spec. The finding is still open.
A human decision must cite the gate that posed its question: an approval is proof of a specific question answered, and binding it to its target is what gives the signature meaning.

A pause is a one-way door: a paused tranche freezes every project in it, a tranche is reviewed once, and closing needs an authorised, in_review or closed tranche. tranches.resume now exists under a human gate; an exit-criteria failure must name its path back in the review itself.
A clean build before a lock regeneration is the only trustworthy verdict: the shared target answered with another session's metadata and the first lock was hashed from a stale binary.
The promotion journal must be validated after every append: trimming by line count silently dropped the publish row, and --check caught it.
A delegation document's owner project is part of its contract: a PLATFORM-owned standing delegation was refused by a P0-only guard until the guard accepted both.
A measurement change resets a benefit profile to draft; activation is a second recorded write with its own version.
A defect with no instrument cannot open a kata: the schema-drift half is re-anchored to T5 with a contract-test instrument class rather than fabricating a measurement.

register_items.body: The broker resolves the binding, checks effect and budget, validates the schema and resolves the credential before any network call, so an unbound, over-ceiling or invalid call is refused with zero destination hits. Recorded retrospectively on 2026-11-26.
